the ideal microstructure is a finely dispersed carbide in a Nb ss matrix. However, in as-cast Nb–Ti–C alloys, many (Nb,Ti)C particles are oversized (the ideal size is less than 100 nm) which is not suitable for Orowan strengthening (dislocation looping).
